reflow_constraints.resolution: Known Standard peak conflict resolved by the reviewed capacitor and footprint. Factory must confirm case-top dwell limits; peak compatibility alone is not a qualified production recipe.

assembly_review.scope: Catalog service eligibility is not solder-process qualification. D10 MSL 4 handling and all exact-part thermal limits require the factory process review; a 260 C solder-heat reliability test is not a reflow recipe.
